text: Catholic priest Sang-hyun volunteers for [a failed vaccine experiment|origin|monsters people made], and after a blood transfusion recovers so fast that his parishioners believe he can heal. At his childhood friend Kang-woo's [weekly mahjong night|images|gatherings, games and closeness] he is drawn to Kang-woo's wife Tae-ju, just as he [wakes needing shelter from the sun and thirsting for blood|threat|blood drinkers]. Stealing transfusion packs to avoid murder, he begins an affair with Tae-ju, who answers his plea to run away by suggesting [they kill her husband instead|wrong|killing within the family].
